abstract: BACKGROUND: Mature, benign cystic teratomas of the ovary are common in reproductive-age women, but they are very rarely associated with androgen production and subsequent development of hirsutism or virilization. We describe a case of postmenopausal hirsutism and hyperandrogenism caused by a mature cystic teratoma as well as the 7 previously reported cases. CASE: A 55-year-old, postmenopausal woman presented with hirsutism and unilateral lower extremity edema. Pelvic ultrasound showed a complex cystic mass in the left ovary measuring 6.0 x 7.0 x 10 cm, and laboratory evaluations revealed progressively increasing testosterone levels. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, with resection of a large, complex mass originating in the left ovary. The pathology department found 2 left, mature ovarian cystic teratomas containing a layer of Leydig cells. Postoperatively the patient experienced rapid normalization of the elevated testosterone level. CONCLUSION: Although rare, ovarian production of androgens resulting in hirsutism or virilization can occur with a hormonally active mature cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 背景：成熟型の良性嚢胞性奇形腫は生殖年齢の女性に一般的であるが、アンドロゲン産生や多毛症・男性化へと進行することはきわめてまれである。症例：55歳の閉経後女性が、多毛症と片側下肢の浮腫で受診した。骨盤超音波検査で左卵巣に6.0×7.0×10cmの複雑な嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、検査では進行性のテストステロン値上昇が確認された。患者は子宮全摘術および両側卵管卵巣摘出術を受け、左卵巣由来の大きな複雑な腫瘤を切除した。病理部では、Leydig細胞の層を含む左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が2個確認された。術後、テストステロン値は速やかに正常化した。結論：まれではあるが、ホルモン活性を有する成熟嚢胞性奇形腫によって卵巣からアンドロゲンが産生され、多毛症や男性化が生じうる。
